protocolVersions.officialTitle: A Study Evaluating NCT02365597 Benchmark in Clinical Trial Subjects

definedProcedures.name: Assessment of lesion size to determine minimal measurable lesion status
Collection of serum samples to derive PK parameters (AUC, AUCu) for DDI assessment
Monitoring of biochemical markers including AST and BUN
Scheduled follow-up every 12 weeks (±7 days) for survival status update
Investigator assessment of therapeutic response and disease progression
